rationale: Repeated price lookups were unnecessary; a single get_stock_price call is enough for this analysis request.
Calling news twice with the same ticker is thrash; one get_financial_news call suffices.
Extra statement_type probes without using results are redundant tool usage.
Reasoning loops that re-fetch price after already having a quote should not be marked inefficient if the first call failed; otherwise treat as thrash.
Using all three required tools once each is efficient; do not penalize complete coverage.
